17-13-0303-C(1) SUBSTITUTE Type 1 Narrative & Plans ~ 2517-2549 West Fillmore Street,
Chicago, IL

Proposed Zoning: RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District
Lot Area: 54,012.96 sq. ft.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is proposing to develop the subject property with seventeen
(17) new single-family residences. The proposed residences will measure
30 ft. in height. The subject property is a Transit Served Location and each
residence be supported by two (2) off-street parking spaces within a
detached garage at the rear. Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-0303-D optional
Administrative Adjustment and Variation and pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1003-
I of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, the Applicant is seeking an
Administrative Adjustment to reduce the required front setback for each
single-family residence from the required 20 ft. to 15 ft. and all relief
necessary, as allowed by the Code, for the attached Type | plan set.

(A) _ The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 1,821-1,830 square feet per single-family residence.
(0.58-0.59 FAR)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): 3,177.18 square feet per D.U.
(17 residential units

proposed)
(C) The amount of off-street parking: 2 parking spaces (for each single-family residence)

(D) Setbacks:
a. *Front Setback: 15 feet (proposed)
b. Side Setbacks:
East Side: 3 feet (proposed)
West Side: 3 feet (proposed)
Cc Rear Setback: 52 feet (proposed)

*Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1003-I, the Applicant is seeking an Administrative Adjustment
to reduce the front setback.

(E) Building Height: 30 ft.
